notes.title: Controller Support first part: Build 0.61
notes.content:
We added a first version of controller support. We tested it with an XBox One controller, please give us feedback of your experience with other controllers:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/controller_support.jpg[/img]

Just start the game and select your timezone (or New Game) and then you can switch to Controller Support in the options panel.

What works:

* Walking : Left stick
* Action panel : X, A, B buttons
* Open inventory: Y button
* Switch players: Right bumper
* Turn camera: Right stick

The China timezone is also developing greatly:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/china2.jpg[/img]

In this version we let you run around in China after the middle ages level a little bit, but there is still a lot of work to be done til we complete this world also.

Stay tuned and have fun with Erwin's Timewarp.

notes.title: Ideas choosing levels
notes.content:
We are currently discussing the idea of letting the player choose the level with buttons on the start screen. Here is a screenshot of the concept:

[img]http://jayanam.com/img/etw/timezone_select.jpg[/img]

First you can choose "New Game" or select a saved game, and then the buttons for the timezone will be active and you can select to which timezone you want to go.

This would be cool but there is a problem with loading and saving the game:

1. Each level needs to be a separate adventure, that has no connection to a previous level

2. When saving a game, should be persisted which level you already finished?

3. It needs to be stored (globally) which parts of the time machine you already found.

What do you guys think of the idea?
